video_title: Sam Amick shares his latest intel on Doug Christie, Domantas Sabonis & all things Sacramento Kings

quotes.speaker: Carmichael Dave
quotes.summary_phrase: Sacramento Kings signing Mason Plumlee to add depth at center
quotes.excerpt: the Sacramento Kings shake the NBA world by signing Mason Plumlee

text_blocks.speaker: Carmichael Dave
text_blocks.text: The Sacramento Kings shake the NBA world by signing Mason Plumlee. I am joking around, and that is certainly no offense to Mason Plumlee. A lot of questions I have been digging this morning, you have probably already dug, and talking to people that know things. The big question is why not a backup point guard? Why not somebody to take the pressure off of Darius Garland?

text_blocks.speaker: Jason Ross
text_blocks.text: For sure, and I had not confirmed his name, but I know Mark Stein had said they connected with Gabe Vincent as a possibility. That makes a lot of sense to be honest.

quotes.speaker: Carmichael Dave
quotes.summary_phrase: Kings prioritizing development of Davion Mitchell and Malik Monk
quotes.excerpt: we are obviously dealing a lot with the future of Doug Christie

text_blocks.speaker: Carmichael Dave
text_blocks.text: We are obviously dealing a lot with the future of Doug Christie. I know you wrote about it yesterday, just about trying to get healthy, give him a shot there, this month is important. I keep wrestling with whether it is Davion Mitchell being traded in part, as you said, because of the prioritization of Sharps and Malik Monk. And now we are talking about Malik's minutes.

text_blocks.speaker: Jason Ross
text_blocks.text: I for sure knew that they wanted a backup ball handler. Honestly, it is the continued fallout from the Ben Simmons injury to some degree. The conversations I have had was like, who the heck is out there? So I actually think Gabe is an okay name. We will see if that happens.

quotes.speaker: Carmichael Dave
quotes.summary_phrase: Mark Jackson's potential connection to the Sacramento Kings coaching staff
quotes.excerpt: Mark Jackson to this franchise is the Zach LaVine of coaches

text_blocks.speaker: Carmichael Dave
text_blocks.text: Mark Jackson to this franchise is the Zach LaVine of coaches in the sense that this is somebody that has been floated around a while. You always worry about the Warriors connection and the lore is that the Vivek Ranadive has had a long time fascination with Mark, who comes with his own baggage. And also of the names we have mentioned, might be the guy that is not Jason Kidd with ESPN, not Thibodeau who is a winner and has options, Mark is trying to do last I checked anything he can to get back into the league.

text_blocks.speaker: Jason Ross
text_blocks.text: To your Mark Jackson question, I have not had anybody add legitimacy to that other than it was not necessarily shot down, but it was not seemingly a priority. It just went nowhere if that makes sense.

quotes.speaker: Carmichael Dave
quotes.summary_phrase: Domantas Sabonis's recent performance and frustration on the court
quotes.excerpt: I had more than a few Kings fans, in fact there was a media member, that said he was quiet quitting

text_blocks.speaker: Carmichael Dave
text_blocks.text: I want to ask you about Domantas Sabonis. I had some people after his last game, probably the worst game of his career, it was the worst considering the minutes when it comes to scoring. And I had more than a few Kings fans, in fact there was a media member, that said he was quiet quitting on the Kings. Now look man, maybe, and I know it is not good to make a living defending anything Kings right now, but he can be upset, we know about his camp, we know about the history, we know about Mike Brown. There is a lot of stuff we could talk about with Domantas Sabonis that may not be the best for his PR with Kings fans, but I do not see him quitting on the team.

text_blocks.speaker: Jason Ross
text_blocks.text: Yes, I generally hate that we are not mind readers. There is no way you can source the fact that he quit. That was sheer speculation. I agree that it is irresponsible. I thought that was a bad look. But it was a pretty bad performance as well. It was incredible.
